article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under new rules

tasks.prompt: What change will the stricter guidance require in schools in England?
options: Pupils will be unable to keep phones on them during the school day
Only social-media apps will be blocked on school Wi-Fi
Phones will be permitted during breaks but not lessons
Each pupil will receive a government-funded locker
tasks.correct_answer: Pupils will be unable to keep phones on them during the school day
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההנחיות המחמירות קובעות שתלמידים לא יוכלו להחזיק את הטלפונים על גופם במהלך יום הלימודים.

tasks.prompt: When are the stricter rules expected to come into force?
options: June 2026
March 2027
September 2027
January 2028
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השינוי המחמיר אמור להיכנס לתוקף בספטמבר 2027.

tasks.prompt: What does “no see, no hear” mean in the current school-phone policies described?
options: Phones must be handed to teachers every morning
Phones may remain in bags if they are neither visible nor audible
Phones can be used only for silent educational activities
Schools must block cameras and speakers
tasks.correct_answer: Phones may remain in bags if they are neither visible nor audible
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר מדיניות שבה אפשר להשאיר את הטלפון בתיק כל עוד לא רואים ולא שומעים אותו.

tasks.prompt: Which practical concern did school leaders emphasise?
options: Parents would refuse to collect confiscated phones
Teachers would need new social-media accounts
Pupils would switch to laptops during lessons
Secure pouches or storage for every pupil could be very costly
tasks.correct_answer: Secure pouches or storage for every pupil could be very costly
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ראשי האיגודים הדגישו שאמצעי אחסון מאובטחים לכל תלמיד עלולים לעלות סכום משמעותי ולדרוש מימון.

tasks.prompt: Who will decide how an individual school follows the guidance?
options: The school itself
The local police
Mobile-phone companies
The Children's Commissioner
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שבתי הספר יוכלו לבחור כיצד ליישם את ההנחיות, למשל כיסים נעולים, לוקרים או איסוף טלפונים.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does it mean that education is “devolved”?
options: All rules are set by the UK Parliament
School leaders can ignore national law
Different UK nations control their own education approaches
Phone policy has been transferred to technology companies
tasks.correct_answer: Different UK nations control their own education approaches
tasks.explanation_hebrew: devolved פירושו שסמכויות החינוך מסורות לממשלים השונים, ולכן אנגליה, סקוטלנד, ויילס וצפון אירלנד נוקטות גישות שונות.

tasks.prompt: Why do union leaders say clarity in the guidance is not enough for schools to implement it?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הפער בין הנחיה ברורה לבין המשאבים הדרושים ליישומה, עם דוגמה מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Schools may need lockable pouches, lockers, collection systems or other secure storage
Union leaders say implementation is not feasible without government funding

tasks.prompt: Summarise the government's argument for the stricter phone rules and the main objection from school leaders.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג באופן מאוזן את נימוק הממשלה ואת טענת העלות/המימון של ראשי בתי הספר.
expected_points: The government says phone access distracts pupils from learning and one another
Its message is that school is for learning and friendship rather than scrolling
School leaders accept phones can be distracting or create safety issues
They warn that secure enforcement will cost money and needs funding

tasks.prompt: Why does the report discuss Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland after explaining the rules for England?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: התשובה צריכה לקשר בין האצלת סמכויות בחינוך לבין הבדלים במדיניות בין ארבע אומות בריטניה.
expected_points: Education policy is devolved across the UK
The other nations are considering or using different legal and school-led approaches
The England guidance does not automatically apply across the whole UK

tasks.prompt: Write a brief comparison of two ways schools may keep phones away from pupils during the day, including one practical advantage or challenge.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות שתי שיטות שמופיעות בכתבה ולהוסיף יתרון או קושי הגיוני המבוסס על הדיווח.
expected_points: Possible methods include sealed pouches, secure lockers, collection at the start of the day or a complete site ban
The comparison should explain how each prevents pupils keeping phones in pockets or bags
A practical challenge may include cost, secure storage or administration
